title: Standard promotion scoped by store and user profile
summary: Built-in promotions can be limited to a store (or all) and to a user profile (or all). They apply on cart events, not necessarily to listing prices.
when_to_use: a discount applied in the cart for a customer group modelled as a User Profile
not_for: scoping by Account or account group (not stated in the KB)
changing the price shown on the product listing (promotions run on cart events)

contract.scoping: Store, User Profile; target products, brands, catalogs, categories, shipping methods (KB)
contract.timing: cart events: add, update, view cart, checkout (Promotion Extensibility Developer Guide)

evidence.note: scoping options: store and user profile; account and account group not stated

limitations: Account and account group are not scoping options in the KB article
Whether the 'Amount/Percent Off Displayed Product Price' type changes listing prices is not verified

unverified: stacking and global promotion/coupon settings on the customer's version
